title: A plant's sugar route
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Phloem transports sugars from sources to sinks. In this example the mature leaf supplies a growing root; source and sink roles can change with development.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain phloem from source leaf to sink root in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: A mature leaf is a sugar source and a growing root is a sugar sink. Through phloem, where can sugar move? Phloem transports sugars from sources to sinks. In this example the mature leaf supplies a growing root; source and sink roles can change with development.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
